vBRIEFInfo.description: E2E: WebRTC Playwright 2-browser — two real browser contexts negotiate WebRTC via in-process signaling relay

narratives.Description: Highest-fidelity WebRTC E2E: two real Chromium browser contexts negotiate WebRTC with each other using real ICE, real DTLS, and real SCTP. Architecture: (1) Build a browser bundle of libxumux (src/index.ts + src/transports/webrtc-adapter.ts) using Vite or esbuild — output to tests/e2e/browser-bundle/. (2) Start a minimal local HTTP server (e.g. using serve or a tiny http.createServer) to serve the bundle. (3) Start a minimal WebSocket signaling relay server (ws package) on a random port — the two browser pages POST/receive SDP offers, answers, and ICE candidates through it. (4) Launch two Playwright Chromium contexts (or two tabs of the same context). Page A = xumux client (creates RTCPeerConnection, creates DataChannel, generates offer, sends via signaling). Page B = xumux server (receives offer, creates answer, waits for DataChannel via ondatachannel). (5) Once DataChannels are open, each page calls new WebRTCAdapter(dc) and XumuxClient/XumuxServer respectively. (6) Pages run the 5 standard E2E protocol scenarios via page.evaluate() bridge calls. Results are returned to the test via Playwright's page.evaluate return values. Browser bundle must include only browser-safe code (no tcp-adapter, no stdio-adapter imports). Browser tests may require --allow-insecure-localhost or a self-signed DTLS cert for loopback ICE (Chrome may block). Alternative: use webrtc-adapter or chrome://flags/#allow-insecure-localhost. Tasks added: task e2e:webrtc:browser (builds bundle + runs Playwright). Playwright config: playwright.config.ts targeting Chromium headless. CI note: requires Playwright Chromium installed (npx playwright install chromium).
narratives.Traces: FR-13 (WebSocket adapter, browser), FR-14 (WebRTC DataChannel adapter), NFR-1 (isomorphic browser support)
narratives.Files: tests/e2e/webrtc-browser.spec.ts (Playwright test, uses @playwright/test), tests/e2e/browser-bundle/build.ts (Vite/esbuild browser bundle script), tests/e2e/signaling-server.ts (tiny ws relay for SDP/ICE), playwright.config.ts (Chromium headless config), Taskfile.yml (add e2e:webrtc:browser task), package.json (already has @playwright/test; add vite if not present)
narratives.NewDevDeps: vite ^6.x (or esbuild ^0.x) for browser bundle; @playwright/test already installed; npx playwright install chromium required
narratives.Acceptance: task e2e:webrtc:browser exits 0 in headless Chromium. All 5 protocol scenarios pass in a real browser-to-browser WebRTC session. ICE negotiation completes within 15 seconds. Bundle size under 100 KB gzipped.
